narrative: On the board. One leaf taken from a folder at the desk under the west window, afternoon light, the pen capped. A single line in his hand. Nothing written above it. On the board. The same leaf returned to the folder. No second line. No number. No name. The pen is still capped.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Opened the folder, left the line as it stood, and did not hand the leaf to anyone.

entities.name: draft
entities.context: Shown on draft in The line, still in the folder
